subject: Virtual onsite — compact mosaic shift
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@targetai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Virtual onsite — compact mosaic shift

Hi Emily —

Thanks for taking the time with us last week. We’d like to schedule a virtual onsite / full-loop for the Senior ML Engineer role. I’ve attached a draft agenda (virtual-onsite-agenda_v2.pdf) and a short candidate brief.

Two compact options that work on our side — please reply with your preference and timezone and we’ll lock it in:

Option A (preferred by hiring team): Tuesday, June 6 (PST) — morning block
- 09:00–10:00: Technical deep-dive (Karthik lead)
- 10:15–11:00: System design (Soojin lead)
- 11:15–12:00: Product + cross-functional (Laura)
- 12:00–12:30: Lunch / 30m break
- 12:30–13:00: Culture / leadership chat + wrap (panel)
- 13:30–14:00: Debrief (internal)

Option B: Wednesday, June 7 — afternoon compact (shorter windows, 45m each)

We can accommodate an extended deep-dive if you prefer — that’s why we suggested the morning block. Please confirm Option A or B and whether 09:00 PT works, or share two windows that work for you.

If helpful I can also convert times to your local zone and send calendar invites once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: virtual-onsite-agenda_v2.pdf; candidate-brief-Emily-Zhao.pdf

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@targetai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite — compact mosaic shift

Hi Marissa —

Thanks, Option A on Tuesday, June 6 works great for me. Morning PST is ideal — please book 09:00 PT for the technical deep-dive. I’d prefer the extended deep-dive if Karthik and the team are open to 60 minutes.

I’ll review the agenda and drop any questions in a follow-up. My timezone is US Pacific.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Senior Research Engineer | TargetAI
emily.zhao@targetai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@targetai.com>
Date: 2028-05-26T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite — compact mosaic shift

Team —

Emily confirmed Option A for Tue, June 6 (morning PST) and asked for a 60m technical deep-dive. Please see my recommended panel sequencing below — aim is to keep focused blocks and a short internal debrief so folks can capture notes while fresh. Laura, can you send calendar invites once we lock the exact times?

Proposed sequence (tentative times PST):
- 09:00–10:00: Technical deep-dive (60m) — Karthik lead; ask deep system-level prompt + code walkthrough (candidate pre-read attached)
- 10:10–10:50: System design (40m) — Soojin lead; leave 10m buffer for brief stretch
- 11:00–11:30: Product + cross-functional (30m) — Laura lead; focus on tradeoffs and roadmap fit
- 11:30–12:00: Culture / leadership (30m) — panel; closure + Qs
- 12:30–13:00: Internal debrief (30m) — owner: Soojin; rubric link in agenda

Action items / asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm you can own 09:00–10:00 and lead the deep-dive? If so, we’ll extend the slot to 60m and adjust subsequent slots.
- Soojin: please confirm you can cover system design and own the 30-minute debrief notes + rubric consolidation.
- Laura: please draft calendar invites and include candidate brief + agenda; include a Slack channel for the loop (I’ll create one).
- Everyone: add 10m buffer between slots for quick notes / break.

Attachments: candidate-brief-Emily-Zhao.pdf, virtual-onsite-agenda_v2.pdf

Thanks — aiming to finalize today so invites go out.

Marissa
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@targetai.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite — compact mosaic shift

Marissa / team —

Confirmed. I can own the 09:00–10:00 technical deep-dive and I prefer 60 minutes — there’s value in giving Emily space for a short code walkthrough plus architecture discussion. One small request: swap the Product slot and Culture slot order (move Culture earlier to close with roadmap / leadership). My reasoning is that after a deep technical session it's helpful to surface culture fit before product discussions, keeps momentum for product follow-up.

Soojin: happy to have you own the debrief notes. Laura: please send invites and include the rubric link (per Marissa) and the calendar buffer.

Thanks — see you all on June 6.

Karthik Iyer
Hiring Manager, ML Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
